      "source": [
        "# Importe l'outil de gestion des fichiers de Google Colab.\n",
        "from google.colab import files\n",
        "# Ouvre une fenêtre permettant de sélectionner un fichier depuis l'ordinateur.\n",
        "uploaded = files.upload()\n",
        "# Récupère uniquement les fichiers dont le nom se termine par \".csv\".\n",
        "csv_files = [\n",
        "name for name in uploaded.keys()\n",
        "if name.lower().endswith(\".csv\")\n",
        "]\n",
        "# Vérifie qu'au moins un fichier CSV a été importé.\n",
        "if not csv_files:\n",
        "# Si aucun CSV n'est trouvé, le programme s'arrête avec un message clair.\n",
        " raise FileNotFoundError(\"Aucun CSV détecté. \"\"Veuillez importer UNSW_NB15_training-set.csv.\")\n",
        "# Stocke le nom du premier fichier CSV importé dans DATA_FILE.\n",
        "DATA_FILE = csv_files[0]\n",
        "# Affiche le fichier qui sera utilisé dans la suite du TP.\n",
        "print(\"Fichier sélectionné :\", DATA_FILE)"
      ],

              "\n",
              "/**\n",
              " * @fileoverview Helpers for google.colab Python module.\n",
              " */\n",
              "(function(scope) {\n",
              "function span(text, styleAttributes = {}) {\n",
              "  const element = document.createElement('span');\n",
              "  element.textContent = text;\n",
              "  for (const key of Object.keys(styleAttributes)) {\n",
              "    element.style[key] = styleAttributes[key];\n",
              "  }\n",
              "  return element;\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "// Max number of bytes which will be uploaded at a time.\n",
              "const MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE = 100 * 1024;\n",
              "\n",
              "function _uploadFiles(inputId, outputId) {\n",
              "  const steps = uploadFilesStep(inputId, outputId);\n",
              "  const outputElement = document.getElementById(outputId);\n",
              "  // Cache steps on the outputElement to make it available for the next call\n",
              "  // to uploadFilesContinue from Python.\n",
              "  outputElement.steps = steps;\n",
              "\n",
              "  return _uploadFilesContinue(outputId);\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "// This is roughly an async generator (not supported in the browser yet),\n",
              "// where there are multiple asynchronous steps and the Python side is going\n",
              "// to poll for completion of each step.\n",
              "// This uses a Promise to block the python side on completion of each step,\n",
              "// then passes the result of the previous step as the input to the next step.\n",
              "function _uploadFilesContinue(outputId) {\n",
              "  const outputElement = document.getElementById(outputId);\n",
              "  const steps = outputElement.steps;\n",
              "\n",
              "  const next = steps.next(outputElement.lastPromiseValue);\n",
              "  return Promise.resolve(next.value.promise).then((value) => {\n",
              "    // Cache the last promise value to make it available to the next\n",
              "    // step of the generator.\n",
              "    outputElement.lastPromiseValue = value;\n",
              "    return next.value.response;\n",
              "  });\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "/**\n",
              " * Generator function which is called between each async step of the upload\n",
              " * process.\n",
              " * @param {string} inputId Element ID of the input file picker element.\n",
              " * @param {string} outputId Element ID of the output display.\n",
              " * @return {!Iterable<!Object>} Iterable of next steps.\n",
              " */\n",
              "function* uploadFilesStep(inputId, outputId) {\n",
              "  const inputElement = document.getElementById(inputId);\n",
              "  inputElement.disabled = false;\n",
              "\n",
              "  const outputElement = document.getElementById(outputId);\n",
              "  outputElement.innerHTML = '';\n",
              "\n",
              "  const pickedPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "    inputElement.addEventListener('change', (e) => {\n",
              "      resolve(e.target.files);\n",
              "    });\n",
              "  });\n",
              "\n",
              "  const cancel = document.createElement('button');\n",
              "  inputElement.parentElement.appendChild(cancel);\n",
              "  cancel.textContent = 'Cancel upload';\n",
              "  const cancelPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "    cancel.onclick = () => {\n",
              "      resolve(null);\n",
              "    };\n",
              "  });\n",
              "\n",
              "  // Wait for the user to pick the files.\n",
              "  const files = yield {\n",
              "    promise: Promise.race([pickedPromise, cancelPromise]),\n",
              "    response: {\n",
              "      action: 'starting',\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  };\n",
              "\n",
              "  cancel.remove();\n",
              "\n",
              "  // Disable the input element since further picks are not allowed.\n",
              "  inputElement.disabled = true;\n",
              "\n",
              "  if (!files) {\n",
              "    return {\n",
              "      response: {\n",
              "        action: 'complete',\n",
              "      }\n",
              "    };\n",
              "  }\n",
              "\n",
              "  for (const file of files) {\n",
              "    const li = document.createElement('li');\n",
              "    li.append(span(file.name, {fontWeight: 'bold'}));\n",
              "    li.append(span(\n",
              "        `(${file.type || 'n/a'}) - ${file.size} bytes, ` +\n",
              "        `last modified: ${\n",
              "            file.lastModifiedDate ? file.lastModifiedDate.toLocaleDateString() :\n",
              "                                    'n/a'} - `));\n",
              "    const percent = span('0% done');\n",
              "    li.appendChild(percent);\n",
              "\n",
              "    outputElement.appendChild(li);\n",
              "\n",
              "    const fileDataPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "      const reader = new FileReader();\n",
              "      reader.onload = (e) => {\n",
              "        resolve(e.target.result);\n",
              "      };\n",
              "      reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);\n",
              "    });\n",
              "    // Wait for the data to be ready.\n",
              "    let fileData = yield {\n",
              "      promise: fileDataPromise,\n",
              "      response: {\n",
              "        action: 'continue',\n",
              "      }\n",
              "    };\n",
              "\n",
              "    // Use a chunked sending to avoid message size limits. See b/62115660.\n",
              "    let position = 0;\n",
              "    do {\n",
              "      const length = Math.min(fileData.byteLength - position, MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE);\n",
              "      const chunk = new Uint8Array(fileData, position, length);\n",
              "      position += length;\n",
              "\n",
              "      const base64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode.apply(null, chunk));\n",
              "      yield {\n",
              "        response: {\n",
              "          action: 'append',\n",
              "          file: file.name,\n",
              "          data: base64,\n",
              "        },\n",
              "      };\n",
              "\n",
              "      let percentDone = fileData.byteLength === 0 ?\n",
              "          100 :\n",
              "          Math.round((position / fileData.byteLength) * 100);\n",
              "      percent.textContent = `${percentDone}% done`;\n",
              "\n",
              "    } while (position < fileData.byteLength);\n",
              "  }\n",
              "\n",
              "  // All done.\n",
              "  yield {\n",
              "    response: {\n",
              "      action: 'complete',\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  };\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "scope.google = scope.google || {};\n",
              "scope.google.colab = scope.google.colab || {};\n",
              "scope.google.colab._files = {\n",
              "  _uploadFiles,\n",
              "  _uploadFilesContinue,\n",
              "};\n",
              "})(self);\n",
              "</script> "
            ]

      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Définit les 10 caractéristiques réseau utilisées par PCA et K-Means.\n",
        "FEATURES = [\n",
        "\"dur\", \"spkts\", \"dpkts\",\n",
        "\"sbytes\", \"dbytes\",\n",
        "\"rate\", \"sttl\", \"dttl\",\n",
        "\"smean\", \"dmean\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "# Définit les colonnes de vérité terrain, conservées uniquement pour l'analyse finale.\n",
        "GROUND_TRUTH = [\n",
        "\"label\",\n",
        "\"attack_cat\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "# Regroupe toutes les colonnes indispensables au TP.\n",
        "required_columns = FEATURES + GROUND_TRUTH\n",
        "# Recherche les colonnes nécessaires qui seraient absentes du dataset.\n",
        "missing = [\n",
        "column for column in required_columns\n",
        "if column not in df.columns\n",
        "]\n",
        "# Si une ou plusieurs colonnes manquent, le programme s'arrête.\n",
        "if missing:\n",
        " raise ValueError(\n",
        "\"Colonnes manquantes : \"\n",
        "+ \", \".join(missing)\n",
        ")\n",
        "# Confirme que le fichier chargé possède toutes les colonnes attendues.\n",
        "print(\"Toutes les colonnes nécessaires sont présentes.\")"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Fixe à 12 000 le nombre maximal de flux utilisés dans le TP.\n",
        "N_SAMPLE = 12000\n",
        "\n",
        "7\n",
        "\n",
        "# Crée un DataFrame de travail contenant uniquement les features et la vérité terrain.\n",
        "work = df[\n",
        "FEATURES + GROUND_TRUTH\n",
        "].copy()\n",
        "# Remplace les éventuelles valeurs infinies par NaN afin de pouvoir les nettoyer.\n",
        "work = work.replace(\n",
        "[np.inf, -np.inf],\n",
        "np.nan\n",
        ")\n",
        "# Supprime les lignes incomplètes et recrée un index propre.\n",
        "work = work.dropna().reset_index(drop=True)\n",
        "# Si plus de 12 000 flux sont disponibles, sélectionne un échantillon aléatoire reproductible.\n",
        "if len(work) > N_SAMPLE:\n",
        "  work = work.sample(\n",
        "   n=N_SAMPLE,\n",
        "   random_state=42\n",
        ").reset_index(drop=True)\n",
        "# Convertit le label en valeur numérique entière : 0 = NORMAL, 1 = ATTACK.\n",
        "work[\"label\"] = pd.to_numeric(\n",
        "work[\"label\"]\n",
        ").astype(int)\n",
        "# Convertit attack_cat en texte et supprime les espaces inutiles.\n",
        "work[\"attack_cat\"] = (\n",
        "work[\"attack_cat\"]\n",
        ".astype(str)\n",
        ".str.strip()\n",
        ")\n",
        "# Affiche le nombre final de flux conservés.\n",
        "print(\"Nombre de flux retenus :\", len(work))\n",
        "# Affiche les premières lignes du DataFrame préparé.\n",
        "display(work.head())"
      ],

      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Crée une figure de 8 × 4 pouces.\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))\n",
        "# Trace l'histogramme de sbytes avec 60 intervalles.\n",
        "plt.hist(\n",
        "X_raw[\"sbytes\"],\n",
        "bins=60\n",
        ")\n",
        "# Ajoute les informations nécessaires à la lecture du graphique.\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"sbytes\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Nombre de flux\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Distribution de sbytes avant transformation\")\n",
        "# Affiche la figure.\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
      "metadata": {

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Liste les variables positives fortement asymétriques auxquelles on applique log(1+x).\n",
        "LOG_FEATURES = [\n",
        "\"dur\",\n",
        "\"spkts\",\n",
        "\"dpkts\",\n",
        "\"sbytes\",\n",
        "\"dbytes\",\n",
        "\"rate\",\n",
        "\"smean\",\n",
        "\"dmean\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "# Crée une copie afin de conserver X_raw intact.\n",
        "X_model = X_raw.copy()\n",
        "# Applique log(1+x) à chaque feature sélectionnée.\n",
        "for column in LOG_FEATURES:\n",
        " X_model[column] = np.log1p(\n",
        " X_model[column]\n",
        ")\n",
        "# Confirme la fin de la transformation.\n",
        "print(\"Transformation logarithmique terminée.\")\n",
        "# Crée une nouvelle figure pour observer la variable après transformation.\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))\n",
        "# Affiche la distribution de sbytes transformée par log(1+x).\n",
        "plt.hist(\n",
        "X_model[\"sbytes\"],\n",
        "bins=60\n",
        ")\n",
        "# Ajoute les libellés et le titre.\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"log(1 + sbytes)\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Nombre de flux\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Distribution de sbytes après transformation logarithmique\")\n",
        "# Affiche la figure.\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Crée l'objet de standardisation.\n",
        "scaler = StandardScaler()\n",
        "# Calcule la moyenne et l'écart-type de chaque feature puis standardise les données.\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(\n",
        " X_model\n",
        ")\n",
        "# Vérifie les dimensions obtenues après standardisation.\n",
        "print(\"Dimensions après standardisation :\", X_scaled.shape)\n",
        "# Convertit la matrice standardisée en DataFrame pour faciliter la vérification.\n",
        "scaled_df = pd.DataFrame(\n",
        " X_scaled,\n",
        " columns=FEATURES\n",
        ")\n",
        "# Calcule la moyenne et l'écart-type de chaque feature après StandardScaler.\n",
        "scaling_check = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        "\"moyenne\": scaled_df.mean(),\n",
        "\"ecart_type\": scaled_df.std(ddof=0)\n",
        "})\n",
        "# Les moyennes doivent être proches de 0 et les écarts-types proches de 1.\n",
        "display(\n",
        " scaling_check.round(3)\n",
        ")"
      ],

      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Crée une PCA en demandant deux composantes principales.\n",
        "pca = PCA(\n",
        "n_components=2\n",
        ")\n",
        "# Apprend les directions principales puis projette les données standardisées.\n",
        "X_pca = pca.fit_transform(\n",
        "  X_scaled\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# Place PC1 et PC2 dans un DataFrame pour simplifier les graphiques.\n",
        "pca_df = pd.DataFrame(\n",
        " X_pca,\n",
        " columns=[\"PC1\", \"PC2\"]\n",
        ")\n",

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Récupère la proportion de variance expliquée par chaque composante.\n",
        "variance_ratio = pca.explained_variance_ratio_\n",
        "# Convertit les proportions en pourcentages.\n",
        "pc1_pct = variance_ratio[0] * 100\n",
        "pc2_pct = variance_ratio[1] * 100\n",
        "total_pct = (\n",
        " variance_ratio[0]\n",
        "  + variance_ratio[1]\n",
        ") * 100\n",
        "# Affiche la variance expliquée par PC1, PC2 et leur cumul.\n",
        "print(f\"PC1 : {pc1_pct:.2f} %\")\n",
        "print(f\"PC2 : {pc2_pct:.2f} %\")\n",
        "print(f\"PC1 + PC2 : {total_pct:.2f} %\")\n",
        "# Crée le graphique de variance expliquée.\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))\n",
        "# Trace une barre pour PC1 et une barre pour PC2.\n",
        "bars = plt.bar(\n",
        " [\"PC1\", \"PC2\"],\n",
        " [pc1_pct, pc2_pct]\n",
        ")\n",
        "# Ajoute le titre et le nom de l'axe vertical.\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Variance expliquée (%)\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Variance expliquée par PCA\")\n",
        "# Affiche la valeur exacte au-dessus de chaque barre.\n",
        "for bar, value in zip(\n",
        " bars,\n",
        " [pc1_pct, pc2_pct]\n",
        "):\n",
        "  plt.text(\n",
        "   bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2,\n",
        "   value,\n",
        "   f\"{value:.1f} %\",\n",
        "   ha=\"center\",\n",
        "   va=\"bottom\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "# Affiche le graphique.\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],

      "source": [
        "# Récupère les coefficients reliant les features originales à PC1 et PC2.\n",
        "loadings = pd.DataFrame(\n",
        " pca.components_.T,\n",
        " index=FEATURES,\n",
        " columns=[\"PC1\", \"PC2\"]\n",
        ")\n",
        "# Affiche les contributions arrondies à trois décimales.\n",
        "display(\n",
        " loadings.round(3)\n",
        ")\n",
        "# Crée une figure pour visualiser les loadings.\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(7, 6))\n",
        "# Affiche les coefficients sous forme de carte thermique.\n",
        "img = plt.imshow(\n",
        " loadings.values,\n",
        " aspect=\"auto\",\n",
        " cmap=\"coolwarm\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "# Nomme les deux composantes sur l'axe horizontal.\n",
        "plt.xticks(\n",
        " [0, 1],\n",
        " [\"PC1\", \"PC2\"]\n",
        ")\n",
        "# Affiche les noms des features sur l'axe vertical.\n",
        "plt.yticks(\n",
        "range(len(FEATURES)),\n",
        "FEATURES\n",
        ")\n",
        "# Ajoute une barre indiquant l'échelle des loadings.\n",
        "plt.colorbar(\n",
        " img,\n",
        " label=\"Loading\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "# Ajoute le titre, ajuste la mise en page et affiche la figure.\n",
        "plt.title(\"Poids des features dans PC1 et PC2\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
